description: c-saves: Rust-native world storage engine for Paper 26.3. CRS2 container: CSEC-v3 section codec (compound palettes, vanilla 4-bit width clamp, frequency-canonical order, dense bit-packing), delta-varint heightmaps, per-key field split for entity/POI payloads, content-addressed section dedup with canonical permutation-invariant hashes, chunk-locality-ordered slab packing (mode-aware dictionary), id/varint recipes, versioned shared zstd dictionaries, hot/cold two-tier compression (hot=3: 2.1x faster writes at identical packed size) with auto-pack watermark, transparent Moonrise chunk-IO takeover, Anvil import/export. v0.5.0 SPEED: fused CSEC-to-NBT emitter (zero Value trees on read, was 9x slower than vanilla inflate, now 8x lower p50), batched single-pass section loads, per-thread emit/encode caches, one-pass dense<->no-straddle converters with memcpy fast paths, O(1) recipe-batch index, lock-free segment mmaps. Real JJThunder corpus: read p50 199us->25us, entity writes 6.8-15x faster than vanilla zlib, region import 2.1x faster (zstd-3 hot tier), region read/write latency tails (p90+) beat Anvil. Verified: semantic 946/946, size x2.83 (CI-gated).
